record.meaning: The conditional parallel-copy reading asks where the car is or why it has not arrived. KRAMM remains a literal closing label. The wording is already directly readable from the separate native E witness; this package adds the source comparison for D, not a new message content or evidence that a car was dispatched.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted. The arrival-enquiry and departure wording was already presented for p174 B/E in cases/radio/seifert.md. The new p183 witnesses add coordinate support and a separately priced comparison, not a new claim to that wording or extra message groups.
limits: The printed header says 27, the native D body has 37 observed coordinates, and the comparison model has 36. All three are kept distinct.
One observed final X is excluded only in the conditional model. This is not an erasure fill or an established cancellation/padding mark.
The unchanged E body provides the complete target independently. All 37 possible one-coordinate exclusions in D are priced against that fixed target.
Previously catalogued native witness E is not counted again.
